spec.claim_summary: Buying bitcoin only when price is more than 5% below the recent high is compared to daily dollar-cost averaging from May 2013 to May 2021.
assumptions: Asset BTCUSDT interpreted from Bitcoin mention in claim.
Timeframe 1d assumed from page chart; claim text states no timeframe.
'Most Recent High Price' interpreted as highest high of prior 365 daily bars excluding current bar.
Dip Greater Than 5% encoded as close < 0.95 * highest_high(365).
No exit stated; max_hold_bars 1 chosen to allow re-entry on every dip day to approximate repeated daily buying.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: daily $1 accumulation with overlapping holds / pyramiding and position sizing cannot be expressed; engine tests one position at a time starting flat, so repeated dip-day buys are approximated by consecutive 1-bar holds.

evidence.quote: Don't Buy Until There's a Dip Greater Than 5% from the Most Recent High Price
Don't Buy Until There's a Dip Greater Than 5% from the Most Recent High Price

audit_majors: max_hold_bars: Claim is buy-dip accumulation held to the end date with no sale stated; spec forces exit after 1 bar to 'allow re-entry', converting long-term buy-and-hold accumulation into repeated 1-day dip-bounce trades. This invented exit changes what is being tested and could flip the verdict.
